query: Identify recent transfer-learning/domain-adaptation baselines that can be used for the repository's cross-position HAR research and have verified MATLAB .m code.
assumptions: The target paper experiment is within-dataset body-position-to-body-position activity recognition using the DSADS, OPPORTUNITY, and PAMAP2 MAT files.
A valid no-target-label baseline may use unlabeled target features during adaptation but must not use target labels for fitting or hyperparameter selection.
Recent means roughly 2020 onward; public MATLAB .m availability is a hard eligibility requirement.

scope.primary_question: Which recent methods meet both MATLAB code availability and the project's source-target feature protocol?
not_performed: No method was executed in MATLAB.
No accuracy or runtime result was measured.

methodology.source_priority: Primary papers and author/official repositories; local project files for data/protocol facts.
methodology.screening_rule: Require a verifiable public MATLAB .m implementation and plausible compatibility with position-wise feature vectors, source labels, unlabeled target features, and a shared activity label set.
methodology.negative_search_caveat: No public MATLAB release verified means not located in this search; it is not proof that private or unindexed code does not exist.
browser_queries: cross-position HAR MATLAB domain adaptation code
recent domain adaptation MATLAB GitHub code
